findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian login bundle's loginTotpStep1 now reads "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence. The same wrong string was also put into the Lithuanian account bundle (account/messages_lt.properties line 101). It should be Lithuanian or removed so the English fallback is used.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese totpStep1 replaced with Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in the zh_CN bundle now uses Traditional Chinese (在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：), while the rest of the file is Simplified. It is the wrong script for this locale and should be written in Simplified Chinese.

findings.title: Whitespace left inside <b> tags in identityProviderLinkBodyHtml
findings.body: The fix only corrects `` to ``. The value still has padded text like ` {1} `, which renders with extra spaces. This is a minor cosmetic point.

findings.title: English-file path derivation is fragile and crashes the verifier
findings.body: The English file path is built by regex on the absolute path. The pattern `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` is not anchored, so an earlier `_xx` segment in the path could also match. If the derived English file does not exist, for example a community-only theme, or a _en file in a different directory, a RuntimeException is thrown instead of a clean verifier message. This would fail the whole build, and the exception is not a MojoExecutionException.

findings.title: HTML detection regex only matches lowercase tags and misses closing or self-closing forms
findings.body:
`<[a-z]+[^>]*>` requires a lowercase start and a closing `>`. English values containing `
` or `` are treated as having no HTML. In that case the translation is held to the no-HTML policy and gets false positives. The check also depends on the English file having a well-formed opening tag.

findings.title: replaceFirst with a quoted pattern removes the wrong anchor occurrence
findings.body: `value.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(group), "")` removes the first matching text in the whole value, not the match just found. The matcher is also run on the original `value` while `value` is mutated inside the loop. If a translation reorders anchors or the same tag text appears more than once, the wrong occurrence is removed. This can hide or misreport anchor problems.
